cleanup(bytes32).details: Cleanup caller gets 5% of remaining deposit.      Rest returned to original depositor.

params.pheromoneIds: Array of pheromone IDs to clean up.

confirm(bytes32).details: Alpha paradox: confirmation REDUCES half-life.      First confirmer gets 10% of deposit.      Subsequent confirmers get 10% / confirmation_count.

params.pType: The pheromone type (THREAT, OPPORTUNITY, or WISDOM).

params.locationHash: Hash of the location to query.

returns.intensity: Strongest current decayed intensity at location.

cleanup(bytes32).notice: Remove a dead pheromone (intensity < 1 bps).         Caller gets 5% of remaining deposit; rest returned to depositor.

cleanupBatch(bytes32[]).notice: Batch-cleanup multiple dead pheromones in one transaction.

confirm(bytes32).notice: Confirm an existing pheromone. Reduces its half-life         per the alpha paradox: new_hl = base_hl / (1 + n_confs).         First confirmer gets 10% of deposit; subsequent get 10%/n.

currentIntensity(bytes32).notice: Compute the current decayed intensity of a pheromone.

deposit(bytes,uint8,uint64).notice: Deposit a pheromone at a location in HDC space.

pheromones(bytes32).notice: All pheromone deposits by unique ID.

read(bytes32,uint8).notice: Read pheromones at a location for a given type.

readPheromones(bytes,uint8,uint8).notice: Read pheromones near a query location.

sinr(bytes32).notice: Compute the SINR of a target pheromone against all         interferers of the same type at the same location.         SINR = signal / (noise + 1).
